summary: Built standalone LLM search-loop grader module + tests (no loop integration — that's task #4). File: lib/subconscious/llm-grader.js. Contract: async gradeSearchRound({intent, originalQuery, evidenceSoFar, candidates, round, maxRounds}, {backend, maxCandidates?, maxEvidence?}) -> {continue:bool, nextQuery:string|null, kept:[candidateKey...], abstain:bool, aggregate:string, parsed:bool, fallback_reason?:string}. One structured LLM call per round: builds a bounded JSON payload (intent + original query + projected prior evidence + projected candidates) under a strict-JSON system prompt; parses strictly via extractJson (tolerates bare/fenced/prose-wrapped JSON); coerceResult enforces invariants (kept filtered to real candidate keys so no hallucinated keys, deduped; abstain<->kept reconciliation; continue=false => nextQuery=null; continue=true with blank query degrades to stop; aggregate truncated). On any parse failure OR backend throw it returns the conservative fallback (stop, abstain, keep nothing, parsed:false) and NEVER throws. Backend is dependency-injected (function | {complete} | {grade}; unwraps string|{text}|{result}|{message.content}). createDefaultGraderBackend(opts) wraps the shared lib/llm-backend seam — getActiveBackend(overlay)->provider.callApi for kind:'api' (in-process, no child); an agentic-cli active provider is rejected with a clear error (grader is a single call, not an agent loop), so dashboard backend selection + automode config are shared with the judge. Did NOT modify runAgenticContextSearches or any existing file. Tests: test/subconscious-llm-grader.test.js, mocked backend, 23 cases (continue-vs-stop, query reformulation, keep/drop + abstain selection, hallucinated-key filtering, dedupe, aggregate pass-through/truncation, parse-failure + backend-error fallback, prompt payload shape, default-backend api/agentic-cli paths) — ALL 23 PASS. Committed f3314540 on orch/attempt/7324f0fd-3872-4c3a-a82b-e7b554aea59d-3; working tree clean. Not merged.

subject: Part 2a: LLM search-loop grader module
description: Build a standalone LLM grader module that acts as the agentic search-loop controller. Contract: given (intent, original_query, evidence_gathered_so_far, candidate_results, round_n), return {continue:bool, next_query:string|null (reformulated from intent+evidence), kept:[result keys judged relevant to the intent], abstain:bool, aggregate:string (final synthesized context for the searcher)}. Implement the prompt + call the existing LLM backend (reuse resolveJudgeBackend / the judge backend in lib/judge.js or lib/llm-backend.js so it shares config/automode). Pure module with dependency-injected backend so it unit-tests with a mocked LLM. NO integration yet (that is Part 2b). New file e.g. lib/subconscious/llm-grader.js + tests. Independent of Part 1.
